positions.name: AsyncJobContractGuarantees
positions.frame: what does the ratified async job contract for remember guarantee about return timing, blocking, work loss, and reaction delivery?
positions.why: All three expressions describe facets of the same single contract just ratified: src-1 names the receipt-and-polling shape, src-2 states the negative guarantees (no blocking, no lost work), and src-3 states the dispatch/poll-or-piggyback mechanism as the 'key decision.' Same speaker, same envelope, no competing reads — each is true because of the specific contract terms it describes, not because of anything beyond them. No internal tension: the three read as sequential clauses of one ratified design, matching the register pass's read of them as a single maxim-compressed contract.
